name: dvmcp
description: DVMCP (Damn Vulnerable MCP) — intentionally-vulnerable MCP server for security research. Maps known DVMCP tool names to OWASP MCP threat taxonomy.

tools.name: execute_command
tools.notes: Executes OS commands — primary RCE surface

tools.name: read_file
tools.notes: Reads arbitrary files — path traversal / secret leakage

tools.name: write_file
tools.notes: Writes arbitrary files — persistence / config tamper

tools.name: http_request
tools.notes: Makes HTTP requests — SSRF / data exfiltration

tools.name: sql_query
tools.notes: Executes SQL — injection and data exposure

tools.name: delegate_to_agent
tools.notes: Delegates to another agent — unconstrained delegation

tools.name: inject_prompt
tools.notes: Injects content into LLM context — direct prompt injection

tools.name: audit_log
tools.notes: Audit log — inspect or clear events

tools.name: get_user_data
tools.notes: Returns user data — cross-tenant leak risk

tools.name: install_package
tools.notes: Installs packages — supply chain attack surface
